name: obsidian-organize
description: Obsidian-vault organizer in the hermes-wiki-super LLM-Wiki style. Five skills — bootstrap (vault layout matching hermes-wiki-super), research (stage source material in hermes frontmatter shape), process_clippings (distill raw Clippings/ into leaf notes under wiki/<domain>/), add_wiki (write a leaf note from a topic, free text, or staged file), remove_wiki (retire a leaf note + clean up back-links). Leaf notes use flat keyword tags, a related: list, a TL;DR blockquote, and a ## Related section with [[wikilinks]] so Obsidian's graph view stays connected.
